Texts.Disconnect.ClosedLocally.Title: Disconnected
Texts.Disconnect.HostEnded.Title: The other Mac ended the session
Texts.Disconnect.HostEnded.Detail: The host disconnected or stopped allowing control.
Texts.Disconnect.Replaced.Title: Session taken over
Texts.Disconnect.Replaced.Detail: Another device connected to the other Mac, and they agreed to the takeover.
Texts.Disconnect.PipelineFailed.Title: The other Mac can't share its screen
Texts.Disconnect.PipelineFailed.Detail: Screen capture or video encoding failed on the host. Ask them to make sure NexaDesk has the Screen Recording permission, then try again.
Texts.Disconnect.Network.Title: Network connection failed
Texts.Disconnect.Network.Detail: Can't reach the other Mac. Check the address and port, that they have turned on “Allow remote control”, and the firewalls on both sides.
Texts.Disconnect.PinMismatch.Title: The other Mac's identity doesn't match the saved pairing
Texts.Disconnect.PinMismatch.Detail: They may have reinstalled NexaDesk, or someone may be impersonating them. Check with them first, then pair again with a one-time code.
Texts.Disconnect.NotPaired.Title: Not paired with this device
Texts.Disconnect.NotPaired.Detail: The other Mac has no saved pairing with this Mac. Enter the one-time code shown on their screen to connect again.
Texts.Disconnect.AuthFailed.Title: Incorrect one-time code
Texts.Disconnect.AuthFailed.Detail: Check the 8-character code shown on the other Mac's screen. After 5 wrong attempts in a row, the code changes automatically.
Texts.Disconnect.RateLimited.Title: Too many attempts
Texts.Disconnect.RateLimited.Detail: To prevent code guessing, the other Mac is refusing new attempts for now. Wait a minute and try again.
Texts.Disconnect.ConsentDenied.Title: The other Mac didn't accept the connection
Texts.Disconnect.ConsentDenied.Detail: They declined, didn't respond in time, or nobody is at the other Mac to accept.
Texts.Disconnect.NoCommonCodec.Title: No video codec both sides support
Texts.Disconnect.NoCommonCodec.Detail: The two devices' hardware codecs don't match, so no video stream can be set up.
Texts.Disconnect.VersionMismatch.Title: Incompatible NexaDesk versions
Texts.Disconnect.VersionMismatch.Detail: Update NexaDesk on both sides to the same version.
Texts.Disconnect.TimedOut.Title: Connection timed out
Texts.Disconnect.TimedOut.Detail: The other Mac didn't respond in time. Make sure the address is right and the other Mac is online, then try again.
Texts.Disconnect.InvalidRequest.Title: Invalid connection request
Texts.Disconnect.InvalidRequest.Detail: The address or one-time code isn't in the right format.
Texts.Disconnect.Internal.Title: NexaDesk internal error
Texts.Disconnect.Internal.Detail: Something unexpected went wrong. Try again; if it keeps happening, restart NexaDesk.
Texts.Disconnect.Offline.Title: The other Mac is offline
Texts.Disconnect.Offline.Detail: This device ID isn't connected to the signaling server right now. Make sure the other Mac has turned on “Allow remote control” and both sides use the same signaling server.
Texts.Disconnect.NoPath.Title: No working network path
Texts.Disconnect.NoPath.Detail: Direct, hole punching and relay all failed. A firewall may be blocking UDP, or the signaling server has no relay configured.
Texts.Disconnect.SignalServer.Title: Can't use the signaling server
Texts.Disconnect.SignalServer.Detail: Couldn't reach the signaling server, or it refused the request. Check the server address in Settings and your network.
Texts.Disconnect.Other.Title: Connection lost
Texts.TailscaleAdvice: If the two devices aren't on the same local network, install Tailscale on both, sign in to the same account, and enter the other Mac's Tailscale name. Tailscale does hole punching automatically and relays when that fails, so you don't need a server of your own.
Texts.Reconnecting: Connection lost, reconnecting (attempt {0}, up to {1} s more)…
Texts.Stage.Resolving: Looking up {0} through the signaling server…
Texts.Stage.Checking: Trying a direct connection and hole punching…
Texts.Stage.Verifying: Connected to {0}, verifying and waiting for the other Mac to accept…
Texts.Signal.Online: Connected to the signaling server: others can connect to this Mac with the ID above
Texts.Signal.Error: Can't connect to the signaling server, retrying: {0}
Texts.Signal.Off: No signaling server set: others can connect to this Mac only by address
Texts.Capture.ViewOnly: View only: the other Mac didn't allow keyboard and mouse
Texts.Capture.Active: Keyboard captured: all keys go to the other Mac
Texts.Capture.Degraded: Keyboard partly captured: without the Accessibility permission, system shortcuts like Cmd+Tab still act on this Mac
Texts.Capture.Unavailable: Can't capture the keyboard: grant the Accessibility permission
Texts.Capture.Inactive: Keyboard not captured: click the screen to start controlling
